item.tib: sku gsum rig 'dus dran pa drag phur dam sri kun bsgrol gnam lcags dbal 'khor gsang ba dgongs 'dus las kha byang lo rgyus gsang don 'byed pa'i lde mig
item.coloph: ces pa'i kha byang lo rgyas gsol ba mkha' 'gro 'od ldan gyi zhal lung 'di'ang sngags rig (rigs) ming 'dzin pa tshe dbang 'gyur med rig rtsal gling pa rang la snga phyi'i lung dang / khyad par rab byung bcu drug ba'i nang tshan sa pho stag lo zla 7tshes 1 nyin mdo smad sba zhabs brag dkar nye bar/ g.yung drung bon rdzong gnas mdun 'dug dus DAk+ki ma dkar mo'i (mos) gsang phur gyi dngos grub yod pa'i kha byang lung thob pa dang / sa mo yos lo'i zla 7 tshes 18nub mo dbal phur gsang phug sman gyi khang pa shel 'od 'bar ba nang rig 'dzin yab sras yum bcas kyi (kyis) gsang phur brda lung dbang bskur bka' rgya snyan du brgyud pa'i gdams pa thob nas/ sa mo yos lo'i zla 11 tshes 21 dge nyin sku blar khang gnas kyi sgo 'byed pa'i rten 'brel legs lam gyur nas/ lcags 'brug zla 1 tshes 119 skor rang slob bka' bab dam pa legs dbon mchod nus rtogs ldan sogs bla ma dgon gyi grwa yongs rdzogs dang / rang slob ngu za dbon po 'dra (dbra) sprul bstan pa khro chen rgyal po nang so rin po chen sogs rgyang ring bla dpon du ma dang / rang gi las slob grogs gyur bstan pa dang/ rig (rigs) ldan pad+ma dbang mo sogs kyi rten 'brel dge ba'i sna drangs zab don phab dgos bskul bzhin/ bla ma dgon gyi legs dbon bla brang khang du phur pa'i kha byang sogs sgrub pa las sbyor bcas zla phyed tsam nas dgongs mdzod brda yi rgya bkrol nas phab grub pas bstan pa'i nyin mo srid mthar bar du dar ba'i rgyu ru shog cig/
